svg.text: Turn Sim: what happens in one 0.05 s step (call order, top to bottom)
Left to right: the screen loop (index.js), the run (run.js), the flying files, then what draws. Numbers are the call order. Line numbers are in src/modules/turn-sim/.
owed += dt x speed; while owed >= 0.05 and
a skipped step (run finished) ends the loop
moveAircraft to find holds. Writes onto each
g = turnSimG(G setting or leg G + gError + fix)
omega = turnRateRadPerSec(v, g): one v for all
mayTurn(): follower rule, or clock cue crossed
turn: heading += dir x min(omega dt, goal-done)
or stepLegs() for shackle / cross / check
move: x += cos(h) v dt; y += sin(h) v dt
record(): historyRow (6 pair distances, min sep,
1-3 closure) pushed to rows[]; pairMinFt updated
aircraft[]: { id, xFt, yFt, headingRad, turning,
bankDeg (arccos(1/G) if turning), g, done, cue }
crossings / closePasses: getters; the first read
Before the first step it also plans on copies
record() index.js:81: trail point [t, x, y] per
aircraft (trim to 60 s :93-94), mark each whole
state is read in place; nothing is copied
ui.setTime(state.tSec); redraw() draws the picture on
shown view; queueReadouts(): at most every 100 ms
while playing, at once when paused
reads: state.aircraft (x, y, heading, g, turning),
trails + marks, layers (17 layout keys), settings
(speed, G, direction for circles; MOA size),
draws grid, MOA box, 3/9 line, trails, crumbs,
spacing lines, circles, clock marks, aircraft
On a hidden canvas it draws nothing
reads state.aircraft (x, y, heading, bankDeg), trails,
camera set only by fit() or the person
stallWarning(g, speedKt): speed read as KIAS
Returns rows, flags, notes, summary text
NOT IN THE LOOP: what happens when a setting changes, and what is written back
A any scenario change (typing, menu, button)
index.js:304 stopScenario: (1) a four-ship with a
shackle/cross is moved to Delayed 90, (2) Turn degrees
follow the turn (:317-321), both via scenario.update
pause(); run.reset(settings) -> new aircraft at the
start slots, rows[] emptied, publish(); trails, marks,
bank signs, leg clock cleared; record(); refresh()
then if the person has not moved the view: fit()
Typing 1500 into a box resets 4 times (1, 15, 150, 1500)
run (up to 12,100 steps) just to find the picture bounds;
padded by the turn radius; view.fit + view3d.fit.
My timing in Node: 30-70 ms per setting change, plus
25-75 ms for the first readout (crossings preview)
D what is written back, and where
scenario (81 keys): only from controls, buttons, and
index.js:311, :320. Kept in MEMORY: lost on reload.
layout (17 keys: panels, layers, 2D/3D, paint): saved in
the browser under scope "turn-sim" through app.storage.
Engine state is never written into settings (Start
heading after a new leg is shown read-only).
E what the engine never reads back
history rows (rows[]) are read by nothing on screen: only
the crossings preview (run.js:202). series.js, which would
draw them, is not imported. The screen cannot read the
state.aircraft has no turnDir, so view.js:268 guesses the
circle side from the Direction setting (TODO view.js:267).
shell registry import() -> mount(root, app) index.js:47
layout, views, keys, standards subscription; resetRun()
returned function: pause, unsubscribe, dispose both
views, remove the stylesheet. Shell also stops frames,
redraw(): state, trails, layers, settings, labels()
readoutsAt(state, settings, ...) at most every 100 ms
